texts.preamble: Varun Beverages Limited And Anr vs State Of Rajasthan Through Pp on 20 August, 2018 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan Bench At Jaipur S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 3 Varun Beverages Limited And Anr Versus State Of Rajasthan Through Pp - For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Anuroop Singhi
texts.arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioners in support thereof has relied upon Para 10 and 11 of the petition. It is further contended that shelf-life of second sample had expired due to deterioration and therefore, the petitioners have been deprived of a valuable right. It is further contended that after sanction was obtained by the Food Inspector impugned complaint was filed after a period of four years.
